description: Use this when the user asks which stores have the biggest discounts or "best deals", optionally within a category (e.g. "biggest beauty discounts", "codes for at least 30% off"). Returns stores whose Whale Coupons code gives at least min_discount percent off, sorted from largest to smallest, with code, discount, how to apply it, affiliate shop link and store page. Fixed-amount discounts (e.g. $30 off) are not included because they can't be ranked by percentage. Do not use for a specific named store (use find_coupons).

category.description: Optional. Restrict results to one category.

limit.description: Maximum number of stores to return (1-25).

min_discount.description: Minimum percentage off, 0-100. Default 15. Use the number the user mentions, e.g. 30 for 'at least 30% off'.

name: list_largest_discounts

hint.description: What to try next when nothing or only category results matched.

matched_categories.description: Categories inferred from product words in the query (closest-category results).

shop_link.description: Affiliate link to the store (opens the store with the discount).

title: List the largest percentage discounts
